mentions.name: Transmute
mentions.description: A sound change applier that applies sound change rules to words. New work adds syllable detection so rules can match directly on syllable boundaries instead of matching them explicitly: syllable structure can be defined in the rules file, and a rewritten syllable detector built on parser combinators emits warnings and is being adopted in the sample sound change rules.
mentions.problem: Sound change rules previously had to match on syllable boundaries explicitly; the tool now detects syllables so rules can match directly on those boundaries.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been taking a look at my sound change applier again. I've been trying to add syllable detection to it so that I can match directly on syllable boundaries instead of having to match on them explicitly in my sound change rules.
